verdict.rationale: Muse is explicitly designed for natural-language, chat-based interaction across mobile, Mac, and WhatsApp with 'no learning curve,' letting users just tell it what to do to trigger goals, tasks, and tool-building. This is corroborated by first-party docs (chat interface, goals tab, side chats) though independent hands-on validation is limited to one stress-test report. Missing for 10: broader independent verification of natural-language robustness across diverse tasks, and detail on limits/edge cases of NL command parsing.
